# Warnings the default kernel build still emits. Roadmap 4.18.
#
# A row is the file, the warning flag and the function. Line numbers are not
# recorded. The ceiling is the number of rows. It shrinks when a row leaves
# because the compiler stopped emitting it. It does not grow: the copy on main
# is the parent, and a row that is not in the parent fails the build.
# The kernel is not built with -Werror. Deleting a function to silence a
# line is not how a change goes green.
#
# The default build passes -DSMP (SMP ?= 1). smp_check_in, smp_park_refused
# and smp_checkin_instrument are called on that build. They are unused, and
# the compiler warns, only when a build drops -DSMP. A CFLAGS override does
# that, because -DSMP is appended after the base flags. That build is not
# this ratchet, and the functions stay.

ceiling: 0
